app_model_settings_shape.name: app_model_settings_shape
app_model_settings_shape.value: (jsonb_typeof("app_settings"."model_settings")='object' and "app_settings"."model_settings" ?& array['rankOrder','codexFamilyOrder','claudeModels'] and jsonb_typeof("app_settings"."model_settings"->'rankOrder')='object' and ("app_settings"."model_settings"->'rankOrder') ?& array['Claude','Codex'] and public.awbs_valid_id_list("app_settings"."model_settings"->'rankOrder'->'Claude',0) and public.awbs_valid_id_list("app_settings"."model_settings"->'rankOrder'->'Codex',0) and public.awbs_valid_id_list("app_settings"."model_settings"->'codexFamilyOrder',1) and public.awbs_valid_id_list("app_settings"."model_settings"->'claudeModels',1)) is true

relative_file_path.name: relative_file_path
relative_file_path.value: "attempt_files"."path"<>'' and "attempt_files"."path" not like '/%' and position(chr(92) in "attempt_files"."path")=0 and "attempt_files"."path" !~ '(^|/)[.][.](/|$)'

ci_job_fence.name: ci_job_fence
ci_job_fence.value: ("ci_runs"."job" is null)=("ci_runs"."fence" is null) and ("ci_runs"."fence" is null or "ci_runs"."fence">=0)

evidence_source.name: evidence_source
evidence_source.value: ("evidence"."reference_path" is null and "evidence"."storage_path" is not null and "evidence"."sha256" is not null and "evidence"."size" is not null) or ("evidence"."reference_path" is not null and length(btrim("evidence"."reference_path"))>0 and "evidence"."storage_path" is null and "evidence"."sha256" is null and "evidence"."size" is null and "evidence"."verification" is not null)

hold_lock_target.name: hold_lock_target
hold_lock_target.value: "execution_holds"."lock_state"<>'held' or "execution_holds"."task" is not null or "execution_holds"."conflict_group" is not null

github_scopes_shape.name: github_scopes_shape
github_scopes_shape.value: "github_settings"."scopes" is null or (jsonb_typeof("github_settings"."scopes")='object' and "github_settings"."scopes" ?& array['contents','pulls','statuses','metadata'] and ("github_settings"."scopes" - array['contents','pulls','statuses','metadata'])='{}'::jsonb and "github_settings"."scopes"->>'contents' in ('verified','unverified','missing') and "github_settings"."scopes"->>'pulls' in ('verified','unverified','missing') and "github_settings"."scopes"->>'statuses' in ('verified','unverified','missing') and "github_settings"."scopes"->>'metadata' in ('verified','unverified','missing')) is true

message_participants.name: message_participants
message_participants.value: ("messages"."dir"='out' and "messages"."to_agent" is not null and "messages"."delivery" is not null) or ("messages"."dir"='in' and "messages"."from_agent" is not null)

attempt_end_time.name: attempt_end_time
attempt_end_time.value: ("task_attempts"."status"='running' and "task_attempts"."ended_at" is null) or ("task_attempts"."status"<>'running' and "task_attempts"."ended_at">="task_attempts"."started_at" and "task_attempts"."ended_at" is not null)

node_parent.name: node_parent
node_parent.value: ("wbs_nodes"."kind"='phase' and "wbs_nodes"."parent_id" is null) or ("wbs_nodes"."kind"='work_package' and "wbs_nodes"."parent_id" is not null)
